svg.text: A song is learned once; every transition is planned, checked and played; listeners' ratings steer the next one.
each lyric word placed on the vocal
writes the lyrics when none are found
· each song's analysis, stems, word timings and where the singing is: learned once, used in every mix
or the DJ's own blend, as rendered
steers the next picks and moves
Only signed-in listeners' ratings teach it; the public demo's visitors cannot rate.
